text.zh: 原话逐字保存在原版本区；AI 只在授权的 ai 区做最小整理，永不改动 user 区。
text.en: Keep the user's words verbatim in the original block; the AI only tidies authorized ai blocks and never changes user blocks.

text.zh: 每个数值都写明 provenance（self_report / model_inference / gap_fill）、来源和置信度；AI 估计不冒充自述。
text.en: Every number states its provenance (self_report / model_inference / gap_fill), source and confidence; AI estimates never pose as self-reports.

text.zh: 没写就留空或标「待评分」，缺失不是 0；补值必须低置信度，且不进入校准和准确率统计。
text.en: Missing is not zero: leave it empty or mark it pending; filled values are low confidence and never enter calibration or accuracy stats.

text.zh: 重大事件用唯一 event_id，只在发生日记一次。
text.en: Book a major event once, on the day it happened, with a unique event_id.

text.zh: 先冻结预测快照，反馈到了再评价；数值修正要过 10 日训练 + 10 日检验门槛。
text.en: Freeze a prediction snapshot first and evaluate when feedback arrives; numeric correction needs 10 training days plus 10 test days.

text.zh: 同一范围内，按用户原始表达时间，新规则替代旧规则；原始反馈永远保留为证据。
text.en: Within one scope the rule expressed most recently wins; the original feedback is always kept as evidence.

text.zh: 不等精确数字，先作合理决定并写明理由，报告给用户并邀请反馈，用户可以推翻。
text.en: Do not wait for exact numbers: make a reasonable decision, explain why, report it and invite feedback; the user can overturn it.

text.zh: 每次写入后读回检查；只有真实产物里用上了才记「已应用」，读过不算用过。
text.en: Read back after every write; only a change that shows up in a real output counts as applied, reading a rule is not using it.

text.zh: 用户手填是参考不是命令：原值永远保留并重点参考，AI 结合证据独立决定，并说明采纳或偏离的理由。
text.en: A self-rating is a reference, not an order: keep the original value, weigh it heavily, decide independently from the evidence and explain why you followed or departed from it.
